targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS corrections FROM odds_ticks FINAL WHERE source = 'resync' AND $__timeFilter(dk_created_at)
SELECT round(quantile(0.5)(dateDiff('millisecond', dk_created_at, server_received_at))) AS p50 FROM feed_latency WHERE $__timeFilter(server_received_at)
SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(dateDiff('millisecond', dk_created_at, server_received_at))) AS p95 FROM feed_latency WHERE $__timeFilter(server_received_at)

panels.title: Latency: DraftKings created the change → our server had it

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(server_received_at) AS time, quantile(0.5)(dateDiff('millisecond', dk_created_at, server_received_at)) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(dateDiff('millisecond', dk_created_at, server_received_at)) AS p95, quantile(0.5)(dateDiff('millisecond', ws_published_at, server_received_at)) AS wire_p50 FROM feed_latency WHERE $__timeFilter(server_received_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT $__timeInterval(dk_created_at) AS time, market, count() AS moves FROM odds_ticks FINAL WHERE source IN ('ws', 'resync') AND $__timeFilter(dk_created_at) GROUP BY time, market ORDER BY time
SELECT dk_created_at AS time, side, american FROM odds_ticks FINAL WHERE game = '${game}' AND market = 'moneyline' AND $__timeFilter(dk_created_at) ORDER BY time

SELECT dk_created_at AS at, game, market, side, concat(ifNull(toString(prev_line), ''), ' ', toString(prev_american)) AS was, concat(ifNull(toString(line), ''), ' ', toString(american)) AS now, source, dateDiff('millisecond', dk_created_at, server_received_at) AS latency_ms FROM odds_ticks FINAL WHERE source IN ('ws', 'resync') AND $__timeFilter(dk_created_at) ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 200
